scripts.dev:all: npx moon run web:dev ai-agent:dev ai-agent:celery
scripts.ai:dev: cd apps/ai-agent && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.ai:celery: cd apps/ai-agent && uv run celery -A tasks.celery_app worker --loglevel=info
scripts.monorepo:install: npm install && cd apps/ai-agent && uv sync
